$comment: The sigil square (docs/design/letters.md "Sigils", LORE §4.5 "Drawing a sigil"): the 3 x 3 of the nine chambers a plot sentence's letters are reduced to (aleph 1 ... tet 9, yod 10 -> 1 ... qof 100 -> 1), each root 1-9 once, as rows top to bottom. Today Saturn's square (Agrippa, LORE's reference); LORE has been asked to confirm it. sigilPath (src/sigil.ts) walks the sentence's letters through it.
